post_freeze_metadata_amendments.change: Renamed mountain_area to analysis_group and mountain_area_count to analysis_group_count because these labels are analysis groupings, not evidence of independent mountains.
post_freeze_metadata_amendments.unchanged: Event IDs, group memberships, calibration/check assignments, sensitivity parameters, release rules, mapped-positive rules, and scoring rules are unchanged.

claim_boundary: Mapped-positive coverage tests whether alpha-angle-constrained downslope routing reaches mapped avalanche-positive area. It is not IoU, field validation, a false-positive rate, or a validation of Voellmy dynamics.

release_depth.reason: FastRunoutEngine has no release-depth input; release_size changes the empirical alpha angle and must not be described as a depth sweep.

grid_rule.nodata_policy: masked; never replaced with a safe-looking zero
grid_rule.aoi_rule: Brama events use the complete published DTM extent. SPOT AOIs are each mapped-footprint bounds plus 4500 m and must be completely covered by the acquired DEM.
grid_rule.boundary_rule: A run whose reached or uncertainty cells touch the raster or valid-data boundary is unscoreable even when FastRunoutEngine reports particles_left_the_aoi=0.

release_geometry_rules.brama: Rasterize the published event release polygon without alteration.
release_geometry_rules.spot: Derived proxy only: within the mapped exact SLAB footprint, select 10 m cells whose elevation is at least min_elevation + 0.8*(max_elevation-min_elevation) and whose terrain slope is at least 27 degrees. Use all qualifying cells. If none qualify, mark the event unscoreable; do not introduce a fallback after seeing results.

mapped_positive_rules.spot: Published SPOT avalanche footprint (start through deposit), aval_shape=1 and typ=SLAB. This is not a deposit-only polygon.

metrics.name: mapped_positive_coverage
metrics.interpretation: sensitivity on mapped avalanche-positive cells only

metrics.name: predicted_to_mapped_area_ratio
metrics.interpretation: extent scale diagnostic; not a precision or false-positive metric

brama.lineage_limit: Release and deposit outlines were interpreted from drone orthophotography one day after the 2019-01-15 events; no quantified positional uncertainty or complete surveyed-domain declaration is available.

spot.lineage_limit: Remote-sensing interpretations are mapped positives, not a complete surveyed negative domain; the source provides full avalanche footprints but no separate release polygons for these records.

spot_dem.requirements: Public plain DEM, source URL and checksum recorded in results; full buffered AOI coverage in EPSG:2056.

partitions.note: The check partition is a preassigned lower-rigor diagnostic set, not a field-validation holdout. No parameters may be selected from either partition in this experiment.
